description: Send a message to the guardian agent of a block and get its reply. Rate-limited, and consumes the block owner's LLM budget — use sparingly.

conversationId.description: Reuse to continue an existing conversation

signature.description: BIP-322 signature over `signedMessage` proving control of visitorAddress

signedMessage.description: Exact message that the visitor signed for wallet verification

visitorAddress.description: Optional visitor wallet address. Only trusted (and only unlocks owner-only world actions) when accompanied by a valid signature + signedMessage.

name: bg_guardian_chat
